sloka: ये त्वां देवं ध्रुवं भक्ताः पुराणं पुरुषोत्तमम् ।प्राप्नुवन्ति सदा कामानिह लोके परत्र च ।। ६.१२०.३३ ।।
transliteration: ye tvāṁ devaṁ dhruvaṁ bhaktāḥ purāṇaṁ puruṣottamam ।prāpnuvanti sadā kāmāniha loke paratra ca ।। 6.120.33 ।।

translations.english: 'Those men who shall recite this holy, divine and ancient hymn of praise, this ancient narrative, shall never know defeat.'
